model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model as a function of the number of blanks. The x-axis is labeled "# Blanks" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks starting at 0 and increasing at intervals of 20 up to 60, though the data extends slightly above this uppermost tick mark. The plot contains a single thick, solid light blue line with circular markers representing the "Qwen2.5-VL-72B" model, as indicated by the legend. The line begins at an x-value of 1 with a peak accuracy of approximately 72%. It then exhibits a steep decline, dropping to roughly 22% at an x-value of 2, and continues to fall to approximately 5% at an x-value of 3. Beyond this point, the line levels off into a nearly flat trend, reaching approximately 1% at x=4, remaining steady near 0% at x=5, and ending at an x-value of 6 with an accuracy of roughly 0%. The plot area is overlaid with a background grid of dashed lines corresponding to the tick intervals of both axes.
